title: Let Claude build and backtest your trading idea in front of you, block by block
author: Just-Pomegranate-952
selftext:
I run QuanterLab. You tell Claude a trading idea, and Claude does not just talk about it: it builds the strategy as a circuit right in the chat and runs it on 20 years of market history. Each block lights up while it runs.

Then the result on a card: what the rule made against simply holding the same stock, the worst drop, year by year. Change a block or say the change ("tighter stop", "try it on Nvidia") and it runs again.

The test is strict: tuned on past years only, judged on the years after, which it never saw.

One from the library: buying Cigna after short dips with levels tuned for each market regime made +49% in its test year, holding Cigna +22%.

Connect: https://claude.ai/directory/quanterlab
Free for 30 days, no card.

*Backtests on past data. Not investment advice.*
